description: How a tool finds the map folder without an option (ADR 0020): the one folder directly at the project root whose name ends in .w3x or .w3m, ignoring case; with none there, the one directly under <project root>/maps/, until 1.0.0. Several at the root, or none at the root and several under maps/, is no map folder. `root` lists the entries of the project root besides maps/, and `maps` the entries of maps/, or is null when maps/ is absent: a folder ends in a slash, a file does not. `found` is the map folder's path relative to the project root, or null with `reason`, `none` or `several`. Shared by the tests of reforged-map/typescript-plugin and of the lint rule no-unknown-rawcodes (#595, #582, #694).
